title: Rewrite Once, Validate Anywhere: Producing OWL-Aware SHACL Constraints (Extended Version)
abstract: arXiv:2608.14104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL) is a W3C recommendation to express syntactic constraints, called shapes, on RDF graphs. SHACL validators are used to test whether a given graph adheres to such a shape. However, RDF graphs often come with OWL ontologies, whose implicit knowledge needs to be taken into account. This is classically handled by first applying reasoning and then performing the constraint checking on the results, often using different technologies which makes the process inefficient and vulnerable for mistakes.   To overcome this, we propose to internalise the OWL axioms in the SHACL constraints; we construct a rewriting which takes as input both shapes and an OWL EL$^-$ ontology -- a fragment of OWL EL restricting the usage of existential restrictions -- and produces SHACL constraints. translated_title: 一次重写，随处验证：生成兼容OWL的SHACL约束（扩展版）
translated_abstract: 形状约束语言（SHACL）是W3C推荐标准，用于在RDF图上表达称为形状的语法约束。SHACL验证器用于测试给定图是否符合此类形状。然而，RDF图通常带有OWL本体，其隐含知识需要被考虑。传统做法是先应用推理，然后在结果上执行约束检查，这通常使用不同技术，导致过程效率低下且容易出错。为克服这一问题，我们提出将OWL公理内化到SHACL约束中；我们构建了一个重写过程，该过程以形状和OWL EL$^-$本体（OWL EL的一个片段，限制存在性限制的使用）为输入，并生成SHACL约束。此输出随后可由任何支持SHACL核心的验证器评估，无论其推理支持如何，同时产生相同的结果。
tldr: 本文提出一种将OWL本体公理重写为SHACL约束的方法，使任何SHACL验证器无需额外推理支持即可处理OWL隐含知识，确保验证结果一致且高效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method to rewrite OWL ontology axioms into SHACL constraints, enabling any SHACL validator to handle OWL implicit knowledge without additional reasoning support, ensuring consistent and efficient validation results.
